guide.title: Field Guide
guide.headline: Be curious. Leave nature undisturbed.
guide.introduction: A short guide to more meaningful encounters with nature.
guide.ruleOneDescription: Keep a safe distance from wildlife. Do not touch, feed, or move wild species.
guide.ruleTwoDescription: Photograph leaves, flowers, or an animal’s body in good light. Avoid flash near wildlife.
guide.ruleThreeDescription: AI results do not replace experts. Verify identity and IUCN status before taking action.

about.title: About RIMBA
about.paragraphOne: RIMBA is a digital encyclopedia developed as an information and learning space about Indonesia’s biodiversity. The name RIMBA is inspired by Indonesia’s natural richness, with its diverse ecosystems that provide habitats for many kinds of wildlife. Through this platform, RIMBA introduces Indonesia’s fauna in a more modern, informative, and accessible way.
about.paragraphTwo: RIMBA is designed to connect the public with information about Indonesia’s many fauna species. This information includes species names, characteristics, natural habitats, geographic distribution, and conservation status. It is organized so visitors can learn more easily and understand the distinctive qualities of each species found in Indonesia.
